<TEI xmlns='http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0'><seg xmlns="http://www.tei-c.org/ns/1.0" type="excerpt" xml:id="ex044032025-05-2118-25-44" status="unreviewed"><milestone unit="section" n="Introductory verse"/>
       <lg><pb n="1b"/><lb n="1b1"/> <l>'thun snang shes bya'i gnas lugs la ||</l> <l>ji bzhin rtogs pa skyed pa'i ||</l> <l>tog <note type="editorial">For "rtog"</note> ge'i rang gzhung bsdus pa'i don ||</l> <l>gzhan la phan phyir cung zad bgod <note type="editorial">For "'god", or "bkod"</note> |:|</l></lg>
       
       <milestone unit="section" n="Body of the text"/>
         <lb n="1b2"/> de la tshad ma'i lugs kyis gzhal bya 'am shes bya'i gnas lugs bstan pa dang | de yul du byed pa'i blo spyir bstan pa dang | sgro 'dogs gcod byed tshad ma'i blo bye brag du bstan pa re shig 3 <lb n="1b3"/> gyis nges par bya'o ||</seg></TEI>
